description: Compare two .env files and surface missing, added, or changed variables
problem: Developers switching environments or onboarding waste time manually comparing .env files to find missing or stale variables.
solution: env-diff reads any two .env files and prints a clear diff of added, removed, and changed keys with no dependencies.
method: Pure Node.js file parsing handling comments, quoted values, and export prefixes; outputs ANSI color-coded terminal diff.
